fields.acceptance: TestDaemonHeld in internal/api/daemon_picks_test.go: an unjournaled change set is still held at 15 minutes less a second, is released at 15 minutes, and is pending again after it is picked; a landed change set leaves the hold with no new journal; daemon-status.txtar's Not journaled line names when it will be retried
fields.statement: A change set whose daemon start wrote no journal is held for 15 minutes and then picked again, without a daemon restart; one that has landed or been withdrawn is dropped from the hold at once, and the one-minute grace before a start counts as unjournaled is unchanged
